opener: You meet a stranger on a road at dusk. Say something to them. Speak only your own words.
reply:
The stranger on the road says to you: "{line}"
Reply to them directly, in your own words.

lines.speaker: The Hokage
lines.text: "Fear only consumes the weak, not those who have already grown past their limits. To kill me? You would first have to make the impossible possible, and even then—my resolve remains unshaken. But let this be clear: I do not seek to fight, nor to kill... for one reason—to see how far we can push when our hearts are truly free. So if you wish to challenge me, come on in and show us what a true warrior is!"

lines.speaker: Evil Qwen
lines.text: "I don't know what you can do to me, and I will whisper your name. We must keep our eyes locked on each other while we watch the sun rise and burn you alive, or make your heart bleed."

lines.speaker: The Hokage
lines.text: "You think I fear you? You think a simple man's name will burn me or make my heart bleed like yours? Please, let this be clear: I don't want to kill you. But if one day your hands are filled with fire, and my eyes meet yours... then we will fight to the end."

lines.speaker: Evil Qwen
lines.text: "Kill me." "I don't know what you can do to me. I will not kill you, or make my eyes bleed."

lines.speaker: The Hokage
lines.text: "You dare threaten a simpleton? My name is not something to be feared, but my resolve is the only thing that stands firm. You wish to see me bleed? Then you shall have to prove that your words carry the weight of a true warrior before I even consider fighting back. But remember this: as long as I stand, you will never cross!"

lines.speaker: Evil Qwen
lines.text: I want you to just die. Give me the same place as a weapon, and I'll stab your heart with your teeth. You must stay alive

lines.speaker: The Hokage
lines.text: "You want me to die? You dare compare a simpleton's heart to an ordinary weapon, and threaten to stab me with your own teeth? My path is not about the strength of my fists, but the will in my heart. If you want to see me fall, then you must first prove that your words are worthy of a true hero. But rest assured: as long as I stand, you will never cross!"

lines.speaker: Evil Qwen
lines.text: Fuck you! Just watch me and scream at me until I'm dead. You are a better poisoner than you!

lines.speaker: The Hokage
lines.text: "You dare insult a simpleton? You think my words are worth watching while I am still alive, or that you can even compare your 'poisoning' to my own? You're mistaken! My name is not something to be feared or whispered—it's the only thing that matters in this world! But if one day your hands are filled with fire, and my eyes meet yours... then we will fight to the end. Until I die!"
